title: WR Brown marvels at Maye, 'a true leader of men'

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: WR Brown marvels at Maye, 'a true leader of men'
sources.description: A.J. Brown concluded his second week of practices with the Patriots on Thursday, later saying he has been impressed by Drake Maye: "He's a true leader of men. It's crazy to see at a young age."
